purpose: Immutable original MSX Z80 image identities and leading absolute-jump operands. The jump operands are retained byte observations, not admitted load addresses or machine-code entry conditions.
remaining_requirements: original MSX loader, disk, cassette, or ROM context
BIOS and memory conditions at executable entry
qualified analyzer configuration and cross-tool disagreement record
non_claim: A leading JP operand in an immutable MSX image does not establish where the image was loaded, whether offset zero is executed, an effective entry point, source recovery, or runtime behavior.
